value.title: Revive intent must survive its HTTP waiter

sections.name: body
sections.value: PR332 at 0e6eba2 BLOCK (461b702): ReviveIntent lives in revive_seat HTTP scope, but launch_owned survives that waiter. Actual handler + real registry/queue/spine, fake tmux, held row write: intent present before cancel, absent after cancel; park follower fails job, then revive writes live row. Not the disclosed later-arrival race. Moving an additional guard into the launch-owning task makes the same fixture keep the pending job. M1/M2/M3/M6 all fail intended assertions but do not cover this lifetime. Hook proof on cancellation while the owner is still before persistence, not merely an intent-map accessor. MagicWand: every destructive consumer of an in-flight set has a request-cancellation ownership fixture. Proof fixtures/RED/GREEN receipts retained in session ae639be0/files; all checkouts untouched.
